what_this_is: A client-side, pure-stdlib check of the published gate against hand-written OpenAI-compatible streaming deltas. No vLLM package, model weights, GPU, tokenizer or vendor endpoint is involved. This record does not measure vLLM or any hosted API.
method: A 5-event fixture stream carrying two parallel tool calls is serialised as OpenAI SSE frames and split into two byte chunks at every offset from 0 to the full length (760 splits); each split is reassembled and validated.

Four constructed corruptions are derived from the same stream: two calls merged into one delta with concatenated argument text; arguments cut mid-string; integer, boolean and array values re-encoded as strings; and all non-string arguments dropped.
The expected outcome is zero rejections for every clean split and at least one specific issue code for every corruption.
interpretation: The gate is demonstrated to be boundary-safe and to catch the four constructed corruption classes in this fixture. vLLM parser behaviour itself was not exercised; the reports in the article remain third-party claims.
not_claimed: no timing, throughput or accuracy number
